subject: how to create my own tabset.

messages.author: d6f9c6ff776783d5
messages.subject: how to create my own tabset.
parts:
Hi everyone,

I'm totally excited to used "shiny", in this moment I have a problem with the tabset, because if created a normal tabset with html "shiny" doesn't work, I believe that it is by json functions, so a want to know, what is the best form to create a tabset?, where can be click in a button and show a div with some functions.

<div class="tabbable">
  <ul class="nav nav-tabs">
    <li class="active">
      <a href="#tab-9953-1" data-toggle="tab" id="t1">Plot</a>
    </li>
    <li>
      <a href="#tab-9953-2" data-toggle="tab" id="t2">Summary</a>
    </li>
    <li>
      <a href="#tab-9953-3" data-toggle="tab" id="t3">Table</a>
    </li>
  </ul>
  <div class="tab-content">
    <div class="tab-pane active" title="Plot" id="tab-9953-1">
      <div id="plot" class="shiny-plot-output" style="width: 100% ; height: 400px"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="tab-pane" title="Summary" id="tab-9953-2">
      <pre id="summary" class="shiny-text-output"></pre>
    </div>
    <div class="tab-pane" title="Table" id="tab-9953-3">
      <div id="table" class="shiny-html-output"></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

specific how can I do a javascript function to show one of tab-pane, because if I use hide and show in a tab-pane with a jquery function it doesn't work, something like this:

<script>
$("#t1").on("click",function(){
$("tab-9953-1").show();
})
</script>

This script indeed show a specific div, but when I want to use some button, it doesn't send a request to server.

Thanks for all!

Note: this is the app that doesn't work. http://spark.rstudio.com/raburgoso/sipgo/

messages.author: 55771919c42cb6a1
messages.subject: Re: how to create my own tabset.
parts:
I think you need to talk to the <a> element, and tell it to show the corresponding tab, as in:
  $("a[href$='#tab-3894-3']").tab('show')

-Winston

parts:
thanks for the answer, 

The problem is that I don't have a <a> indent with a tab-pane, because I need to show and hide various tab-pane with two buttons, next and prev, so I use something like this.

This is the menu:

<ul class="nav nav-pills menu pager " id = "nextprev">
   <li id = "Cargar" class="active"><a >Upload</a></li>
   <li id ="Caracterizacion"><a >Characterization</a></li>
   <li id ="Clasificacion"><a >Classification</a></li>
   <li class="pull-right" id="next"><a>Next</a></li>
   <li class="pull-right" id="prev"><a>Prev</a></li>
</ul>

and I move that with this script:

$("#prev").click(function(){
  if($("#nextprev > li.active").prev().length >0){
    $("#nextprev > li.active").removeClass("active").prev("li").addClass("active");
    menu($("#nextprev > li.active").attr("id"));
  }
});
$("#next").click( function(){
  if($("#nextprev > li.active").next().length > 0 && $("#nextprev > li.active").attr("id")!= "Clasificacion")
  {
    $("#nextprev > li.active").removeClass("active").next("li").addClass("active");
    menu($("#nextprev > li.active").attr("id"));
  }
});

It is working without problem, the function menu() is show and hide all of tap-pane, but when a show one of this, and apply some action, the server doesn't work.

that's why I want to know how to create my own tabset, and if somebody may be know how, or have some help, I appreciate so much.
